scenes.content:
You asked:
"What are the annual filing requirements for a federal corporation in Canada?"
AI Answer:
A federal corporation (CBCA) must:
1. File an Annual Return with Corporations Canada within 60 days of its anniversary date
2. Hold an AGM within 18 months of incorporation and annually thereafter
3. File T2 Corporate Tax Return within 6 months of fiscal year end
4. Maintain up-to-date minute books and corporate registers
